title: Powder Toy building playbook — graded practices, each verified before scaling
how_to_use: Practices are ordered by level. Do level N practices until every 'verify' passes before composing them at level N+1. Each step is a blueprint fragment (see BLUEPRINT_SPEC.md) or an action. 'status' says how far the practice is trusted: verified = reproduced live by us, observed = seen working in community saves and explained from source, proposed = derived from source facts only. Practices may list 'variants': alternative implementations lifted from community saves (cite the save id); use the base steps first, then a variant when its trade-off fits.

practices.name: checkpoint_verify_loop
practices.goal: Never lose a build and never trust a placement response.

steps.do: Pause the simulation before drawing anything (blueprint_build does this: pause=true).
Save a full-canvas stamp before every test run (save_stamp x=0 y=0 width=611 height=383).
Draw with blueprint_build dry_run=true first; fix every error; then dry_run=false.
Verify by census, not by ok:true — count the elements you expect in the box you drew (spatial_snapshot/execute_lua).
Record what you learned with record_build_lesson before moving on.

practices.verify: Census of your region lists exactly the elements and counts you intended; stamp id exists in list_stamps.
pitfalls: Verify by capturing and running, not by reading back the draw result
Placing over occupied pixels silently fails — erase before fill (blueprint 'box' does this by default)
Simulation runs live/unpaused by default -- wall-clock tool latency silently advances real frames
practices.scale_up: Same loop at every size. At >30k particles keep stamps of each section separately so a failed test only rewinds one section.

practices.name: sealed_vessel
practices.goal: A box that holds a liquid or gas with zero leaks.

steps.do: Unpause for 120 frames (set_pause 0, sleep 2.5 s, set_pause 1).

practices.verify: Census outside the vessel box shows 0 DSTW; inside count unchanged (±0).
pitfalls: Bottom vent gap drains liquid fuel under ambient gravity
Draw elements before placing walls
Wall types differ visually and some animate
practices.scale_up: Any pipe or valve entering a vessel must pass through the shell flush and be collared (GLAS/TTAN) — leaks always start at penetrations. Prefer wall types (WALL) as the pressure boundary when the contents will be pressurised (see pressure_chamber).

practices.name: insulated_heat_source
practices.goal: Place a hot element (WIFI, HEAC, PRTO, laser) without cooking its surroundings.

steps.do: Read the WIFI temperature: channel N sits at 73.15+100*(N-1) K permanently. Channel 5 = ~500 K; channel 40 = 4000 K.
Put anything above 600 K inside a 2px INSL jacket; run blueprint_lint and clear every heat_source_uninsulated finding.

practices.verify: After 300 frames the pixel just outside the INSL jacket is within 5 K of ambient (get_field temp).
pitfalls: WIFI blocks are standing heat sources at channel temperature — INSL-jacket every one
WIFI/PRTI/PRTO channel is derived from temperature, not tmp — set temp = 73.15 + 100*(N-1)
Unjacketed WIFI bank inside a GLAS console heat-soaks the glass to 922C (melt edge) — jacket or move the bus
Vacuum gaps don't insulate (air grid conducts); DMND-contained molten LITH works as a liquid breeder module
practices.scale_up: Group all WIFI of a plant into one jacketed bus (wifi_bus_row) with INWR stubs out; keep channels <= 8 near anything flammable; reserve high channels for portals that must be hot anyway.

practices.name: wire_a_signal
practices.goal: Send a spark from a button to a target without shorting anything on the way.

steps.do: Spark rules as measured live (2026-08-25 rigs): a 3-cell PSCN/NSCN chain lit in BOTH directions at frame 1 (the textbook 'NSCN never sparks PSCN' asymmetry did not reproduce in that rig - treat it as unconfirmed); INST floods its whole body in 1 frame; INWR side-touching METL DID pass the spark in the rig, so do not rely on INWR as insulation from adjacent conductors - keep a 1px gap or INSL; SWCH gates when toggled; LCRY lights only on direct PSCN contact (confirmed).

practices.verify: Within 10 frames of the battery being placed the LCRY reads lit (its temp/ctype changes) — census shows SPRK particles along the INWR and none on neighbouring METL.
pitfalls: A conductive floor or plane shorts the whole build
PSCN must touch LCRY directly; 1px gap silently kills lamp panels
INWR (insulated wire) for buried and overhead signal runs — no INSL sheath needed, crossing-safe
Structure gates must count SPRK by ctype — spark traffic masks conductive structure
practices.scale_up: One bus, many channels: convert long INWR runs into a WIFI channel per function; label channels in a table before building (channel_reuse lint catches collisions).

practices.name: tank_with_valve
practices.goal: A tank whose outlet can be opened and closed reliably.

steps.do: Build sealed_vessel with the outlet pipe (PIPE, 3px) entering the tank floor flush; extend the pipe 6px INTO the tank interior and collar it with GLAS.
Close = replace 3 rows of the drain pipe with a TTAN plug (physical valve). Open = replace the plug rows with PIPE; the pipe re-initialises in ~60 frames.
Do NOT rely on PPIP pause flags for a valve that must survive rebuilds — pipe re-init wipes them.

practices.verify: Closed: tank level constant over 300 frames (count DSTW inside). Open: level falls and the same count appears downstream.
pitfalls: Bottom vent gap drains liquid fuel under ambient gravity
Unpausing releases stored dynamics: valve every gravity line and expect DEUT concentration
practices.scale_up: Every gravity-fed line in a plant gets a plug valve; keep all valves CLOSED before unpause; open one at a time and watch the downstream census. For fuel (DEUT) gauge by sum of life, not particle count.

practices.name: remote_flood_and_drain
practices.goal: Fill or empty any chamber from a control room with one WIFI pulse each.

steps.do: Pulse channel 6 from a wifi_node+PSCN button; the DLAY holds the PCLN(DSTW) cloners on for delay_c frames, then they stop by themselves.

practices.verify: After the pulse, DSTW count inside 'c' rises for ~98 frames then plateaus; after pulsing channel 7 it falls to 0.
pitfalls: WIFI-triggered injector pod (DLAY->PUMP+PCLN(DSTW)) and drain pod (BTRY->PVOD) = remote flood/drain for any chamber
Use DSTW, not WATR, for coolant that touches conductors or logic
PUMP columns + VACU sump form a pressure pair that drives a walled fission core
practices.scale_up: One pod pair per chamber, unique channel pair per chamber, all buttons on one console (button_pad + lcry_lamp_13 per chamber for state).

variants.name: PVOD drain
variants.how: PVOD deletes only while its own spark is live, so there is no permanently armed VOID to leave exposed if the gate fails open. NOTE: PVOD-while-powered did not reproduce in the 2026-08-25 live rig (experiment #4) - verify before relying on it; NTCT+VOID is the unconditional fallback.

practices.name: pressure_chamber
practices.goal: Hold a region at a chosen pressure without it blowing out.

steps.do: Walls (wall type WALL) are the pressure boundary — particles are not. PUMP columns raise the interior (+127 measured in save 78400), VACU sump below holds the exhaust negative (-256).
Measure with get_field pressure at the chamber centre every 60 frames until it is stable.

practices.verify: Centre pressure stable within ±5 for 120 frames; pressure outside the wall box stays within ±2 of ambient.
pitfalls: set_field_region takes CELL coordinates, not pixels
Air temperature fields survive particle quenches and re-flash rebuilds on unpause
H2 fusion requires particle temp AND cell pressure simultaneously
practices.scale_up: For a reactor core use the chamber as the fuel bed (fill param) and put the breeder_liner along the DMND walls; the sump doubles as the neutron/heat exhaust path.

variants.name: embedded pump lattice
variants.how: Single PUMP/VACU pixels embedded in a solid QRTZ/INSL lattice spacer every 4-20 rows pressurise many small already-solid cells without a wall frame per cell. Use for fuel lattices; the wall-boxed chamber stays the choice for one open volume.

practices.name: self_healing_liner
practices.goal: A self-breeding wall: a barrier (or fuel column) that regrows after damage.

steps.do: The CLNE is armed with INSL by the compiler (ctype prop) and kept cold; cap both ends with solid INSL so it cannot creep.
Test: erase a 5px gap in the INSL above the liner, run 60 frames.

practices.verify: The gap is refilled with INSL within 60 frames; CLNE count unchanged.
pitfalls: CLNE with ctype INSL makes a self-healing insulation liner
CLNE learns ctype on touch then emits it forever
CLNE armed to NEUT ctype triggers real full-pile DEUT chain reaction fast
practices.scale_up: Same trick gives infinite coolant (CLNE ctype DSTW), infinite cryogen (cryo_column_ln2) and self-breeding fuel (breeder_liner) — but a CLNE armed to NEUT or a hot CLNE is a bomb: keep every cloner cold and away from the reaction zone.

variants.name: self-breeding fuel wall
variants.how: A 477-particle CLNE(THRM) column re-breeds thermite continuously - the CLNE-liner pattern works for any breedable fuel, not only INSL/DEUT. Same cautions: keep the cloner cold and away from the reaction zone.

practices.name: cryogenic_supply
practices.goal: Keep a cryogen alive and deliver it where it is needed.

steps.do: Every cryogen you place must carry props temp_c below its boiling point (LN2: -196 C); the compiler will not do it for you (cryo_no_cold_temp lint).
Route it through INSL-lined channels or an insl_air_shaft; never through METL.

practices.verify: LN2 count inside the column is constant over 300 frames; INSL liner outer face within 20 K of ambient.
pitfalls: Cryogenic liquids spawn at ambient temperature
LN2 is LNTG and dies by deletion at 77K
Infinite cryogen reservoir: INSL-lined TTAN-capped LN2 column with one cold CLNE(LN2) at the core
practices.scale_up: Feed magnets/condensers with HEAC lines from the reservoir (FSN-2 cryoplant pattern: ICE reservoir at 60 K + HEAC cryoline); valve the line like tank_with_valve.

variants.name: on-demand quench nozzle
variants.how: Small LN2 pocket topped up by CLNE(LN2) at rest; a PCLN(LN2) nozzle fires onto the fuel rod only when a TSNS threshold ladder trips - emergency quench instead of continuous cooling.

practices.name: status_display
practices.goal: Show plant state on a panel that a human (or a screenshot) can read.

steps.do: Drive each lamp from a sensor: TSNS (temp threshold in its temp) or PSNS (pressure) -> PSCN -> WIFI on the lamp's channel.

practices.verify: Heating the TSNS above its threshold lights the lamp within 10 frames; cooling clears it via the reset channel.
pitfalls: Control console pattern: SWCH/HSWC button pads per WIFI channel, 13x13 LCRY lamps set/reset by two channels
PSCN must touch LCRY directly; 1px gap silently kills lamp panels
Decoration only lands where particles already exist
Deco alpha 255 fully replaces an element colour
practices.scale_up: One lamp per functional system (fuel, coolant, pressure, cryo, fault); put the console in GLAS but keep the WIFI bus jacketed behind it.

variants.name: seeded GLOW field
variants.how: Scatter GLOW through the core; each GLOW learns a different ctype by touch (60+ ctypes in 2591226), giving a live what-touches-what map of the whole core for far fewer particles than a gauge per point.

practices.name: heat_extraction_loop
practices.goal: Move heat from a hot core to a condenser and back, continuously.

steps.do: Coolant is DSTW (non-conductive). Pipe runs are PIPE sheathed in SHLD (self-repairing). Put a clne_liner under the pipe bundle. Condense in a TTAN box at low temperature; return by gravity or PUMP.
Alternative for distance: a portal_pair (PRTI at the core, PRTO at the condenser) — remember the portal pads sit at channel temperature.

practices.verify: Core temperature (TSNS at the core) falls and the condenser temperature rises over 600 frames; DSTW count in the loop constant (no leaks, no boiling losses).
pitfalls: Sheathe long PIPE runs in SHLD; SHLD self-repairs and its growth stages are normal
PRTI/PRTO channel pairs teleport coolant and heat; portal temp equals channel state
Fusion power train runs steam-dominant: condense-flash-recirculate with a condenser duty cycle
An INSL deck does not stop a METL/GOO surface deck from heat-soaking to one temperature
practices.scale_up: Two independent loops per core (one can be valved off while the other runs); a condenser duty cycle (see FSN-2 lesson) instead of continuous flow; steam turbine hall downstream.

practices.name: fission_core_plut
practices.goal: A PLUT/DEUT core that runs steadily instead of detonating.

steps.do: Order: walls of the pressure boxes first, then DMND/TTAN/NSCN structure, then PUMP/VACU fills, then fuel (PLUT bed, DEUT), then CLNE seeds armed by touch, then pipes/portals, then logic. Keep paused throughout.
Meter the trigger: one small NEUT source (CRAY ctype NEUT fired for <=10 frames) — never a CLNE armed to NEUT touching the pile.

practices.verify: DEUT sum-of-life rises slowly (breeding) and NEUT count stays < 100 over 600 frames; DMND hotspot < 1500 C; no PLUT outside the bed.
pitfalls: NEUT+DEUT fusion trigger = DeutExplosion chain reaction
DEUT reactor yield control: meter the trigger, derate the bed, never rain+boost a full charge
PLUT spontaneous fission under pressure + NEUT interactions
DEUT life=concentration, maxlife formula
Packed DEUT is the stable non-destructive light source
practices.scale_up: Add remote_flood_and_drain pods to the chamber, heat_extraction_loop on the sump, status_display on TSNS/PSNS — that is the whole community save 78400.

variants.name: zero-inventory idle core
variants.how: No resident PLUT/DEUT/NEUT at rest: the charge is a PCLN grid armed to fuel that only synthesises fissile material while the console sparks it, and drains back out through a PRTI floor when power is cut. Preferred cold-start/idle state; keep a resident pile only for the hot demo.

practices.name: fusion_shot
practices.goal: Ignite H2/DEUT fusion on purpose and survive it.

steps.do: Vessel: TTAN structure and blanket (never TUNG — shatters on every shot); DMND rings inside; LITH breeder in double-DMND pods; WATR coolant ring outside; METL cryostat outside that.
Fuel: H2 at ~45% checkerboard density plus a DEUT pool in the annulus.

Shot recipe (FSN-2, proven): sector cells pressure 70 via set_field_region (CELL coords), fuel flashed to 4000 K, then unpause. Ignition is a race between the 1/5 roll and the thermal+pressure quench.
Only NBLE-sourced plasma self-sustains; PLSM melts every structural element and burns out — it is not a light source.

practices.verify: Plasma appears within 60 frames and the TTAN vessel census is unchanged after 600 frames (no TTAN loss, no fuel outside the vessel).
pitfalls: H2 fusion requires particle temp AND cell pressure simultaneously
Fusion ignition is a race between the 1/5 roll and thermal+pressure quench
TUNG blanket shatters on every fusion shot; use TTAN structure + vacuum-insulated LITH pods
PLSM melts every structural element
Only NBLE-sourced plasma is self-sustaining
Controlled vs runaway fusion shot intensities in a TTAN vessel

practices.name: plant_integration
practices.goal: Assemble many practices into one plant without the interactions killing it.

steps.do: Budget: large solid fills dominate particle count — hollow every shell, use wall types for pressure boundaries, target < 60k particles.
Allocate WIFI channels in a table first (one per function, low numbers near fuel/flammables); run blueprint_lint on the whole plan and clear criticals.
Build in this order: walls -> structure -> fills -> fuel -> cloners -> pipes/portals -> logic -> decoration; stamp after each stage.
Commission one system at a time with all valves closed: cryo, then coolant loop, then logic/lamps, then fuel, then the first metered shot.
After every change: census + one lesson.

practices.verify: Each subsystem's own verify passes in situ (not just in isolation) and the whole-plant census is stable for 1000 frames with valves closed.
pitfalls: Large solid fills dominate particle count
Instrument-bay wiring and hardening rules from Torus One commissioning
Rewind ring + registered cleanup + restore discipline
Audit before delete: whitelist sweeps must log offending types first
practices.scale_up: This is the top level; scale by cloning proven sections as stamps, not by drawing new ones.

practices.name: generate_power
practices.goal: Turn heat into a usable electrical signal with realistic parts: UO2/B4C fuel assembly -> steam -> TRBN turbine -> CU busbar -> LEDL, plus a TEG on waste heat.

steps.do: Run python scripts/define_power_elements.py once per game session (custom elements are not persistent).
Withdraw the B4C rod (erase it) to raise NEUT flux; re-insert to scram. Watch B4C tmp (captures) and TRBN tmp (work).

practices.verify: Over 120 frames: TRBN tmp (work) rises, WTRV in the chest falls and DSTW appears, B4C tmp rises while UO2 is uncovered, and SPRK appears on the CU bars (sample every 5 frames).
pitfalls: Power element set verified: UO2->NEUT, B4C absorbs, TRBN steam->work->SPRK, TEG heat->SPRK; bridge needs custom ids
Use DSTW, not WATR, for coolant that touches conductors or logic
WIFI touching coolant boils it; high-channel WIFI melts TTAN — INSL-ring pods before embedding them; check param names
practices.scale_up: Series turbine stages on one steam chest; a boiler between the assembly and the chest (heat_extraction_loop bands 130-180 C); AERO lagging on every hot line; LEDL panels instead of hot LCRY/WIFI for status.

pv_battery_microgrid.note: no Li-ion element exists in our catalog yet -- NAS (300-350 C molten) and PCMP/PCMS (32-58 C phase change) cover thermal/molten storage but not a room-temperature electrochemical cell with a ~70-150 C runaway threshold
verify_bands: a segmented nas_battery_rack with STEL/INSL breaks between cells contains a single-cell breach without heating neighboring cells; an unsegmented rack does not

severing the CU-bus link between pv_array_sipv and the rest of the plant causes downstream LEDL/status panels to go dark within a small frame count while the array itself keeps producing SPRK locally (islanding signature)

geothermal_plant.note: our existing heat_extraction_loop boiler band (130-180 C) coincidentally matches the real 150-180 C flash/dry-steam threshold well -- the one system in this document where no band change is needed
verify_bands: a binary/ORC loop never lets the geothermal DSTW reservoir body directly contact the TRBN turbine -- a second, separate low-boiling-point loop (PCMP/PCMS-mediated) must sit between them
reinjection PUMP pressure pushed past a defined safe band raises surrounding get_field pressure readings measurably, giving an assertable proxy for induced-seismicity risk

practices.name: realistic_fission_core
practices.goal: A UO2/B4C/HF fission core with realistic melting-point margins, contained in a layered STEL/CNCR/LEAD vessel.

steps.do: Run python scripts/define_power_elements.py once per game session (custom elements are not persistent).
Withdraw the control_rod_drive_b4c PSTN (erase the rod) to raise flux past pwr_fuel_bundle's HF trim rod; watch B4C/HF tmp (captures) and UO2's steady NEUT emission. Re-insert to scram.

practices.verify: Census inside rpv_steel_vessel's inner STEL cavity shows the fuel bundle and rod intact after 300 frames with the LEAD layer outermost and unmelted; B4C/HF tmp (captures) only climbs while the corresponding rod is inserted, and no element in the stack exceeds its own highTemperature.
pitfalls: UO2 emits NEUT continuously regardless of rod position -- there is no chain-reaction runaway in this element set (unlike PLUT/DEUT), so 'criticality' here means neutron economy and clad temperature, not an explosion risk
LEAD must be the outermost, coolest layer of rpv_steel_vessel -- it melts at only 327 C, far below STEL (1500 C) or CNCR (spalls at 1200 C)
STEL is the pressure boundary and must always face the fuel side, never the reverse
This practice was authored and compiled offline (2026-08-26); it has not yet been run live in-sim -- treat the operating_bands as design targets, not measurements
practices.scale_up: Stack multiple pwr_fuel_bundle instances inside one rpv_steel_vessel cavity for a multi-assembly core; feed the vessel's heat into a steam_generator (see electrical_generation_chain) instead of venting it, and add a status_display TSNS ladder on the vessel's STEL face.

practices.name: electrical_generation_chain
practices.goal: A full realistic power chain: UO2 fuel assembly -> NAK/steam generator -> CU condenser -> TEG waste-heat panel -> independent SIPV solar leg, all onto one CU bus.

steps.do: Run python scripts/define_power_elements.py once per game session (custom elements are not persistent).
Tie every module's CU bus together with a CU/INWR trunk line; each subsystem contributes SPRK independently (TRBN work pulses, TEG waste-heat pulses, SIPV under incident light) onto the shared bus.

practices.verify: Over 300 frames: TRBN tmp (work) in steam_generator rises while its WTRV falls and DSTW appears; condenser_cu's DSTW bath temperature climbs; teg_wall_panel's TEG cells exceed 100 C and pulse SPRK onto their bus; pv_array_sipv produces SPRK only while PHOT is actually incident on it.
pitfalls: NAK is flammable in air (rating 400) -- keep the primary loop sealed inside steam_generator's STEL shell, never vent it to open atmosphere
TRBN needs WTRV specifically, not DSTW/WATR, to do work
TEG stops pulsing once it drops below its onTemp (100 C) -- site teg_wall_panel on a face that stays hot
SIPV produces nothing without incident PHOT -- this leg of the chain is independent of the thermal legs and needs its own light source
This practice was authored and compiled offline (2026-08-26); it has not yet been run live in-sim
practices.scale_up: Series multiple steam_generator/condenser_cu pairs off one fuel_assembly_uo2 for more turbine stages; add nas_battery_rack or pcm_thermal_battery downstream of the CU trunk (see energy_storage_bank) to store the combined output instead of only showing it on LEDL.

operating_bands.source: derived from power-elements-2026-08-26.json + materials-catalog.json, not yet run live
operating_bands.note: bands are design targets from element data; verify live before trusting exact numbers

steam_rankine_cycle.note: our current heat_extraction_loop/steam_generator bands (130-180 C boiler) run 3-4x cooler than real utility subcritical steam -- a deliberate game-stability simplification, not an error; flag before assuming it scales
verify_bands: raising condenser_cu's bath temperature toward saturation measurably reduces trbn_work_per_120f versus the existing >=20 band with a cool bath
a boiler-tube breach in steam_generator shows WTRV appearing on the wrong side of the former wall and the pressure differential across it collapsing toward zero within a few frames

pv_battery_microgrid.note: no Li-ion element exists in our catalog yet -- NAS (300-350 C molten) and PCMP/PCMS (32-58 C phase change) cover thermal/molten storage but not a room-temperature electrochemical cell with a ~70-150 C runaway threshold
verify_bands: a segmented nas_battery_rack with STEL/INSL breaks between cells contains a single-cell breach without heating neighboring cells; an unsegmented rack does not

severing the CU-bus link between pv_array_sipv and the rest of the plant causes downstream LEDL/status panels to go dark within a small frame count while the array itself keeps producing SPRK locally (islanding signature)

practices.name: chemical_safety_cell
practices.goal: House genuinely reactive chemistry (NA+water, CAC2+water, MG combustion, CAO slaking) in separated, contained demo cells that do nothing until deliberately triggered.

steps.do: Keep every hazard cell physically separated by at least one empty column and its own containment shell (FBRK/S316) -- never share a wall between two independent reactive-chemistry demos.

practices.verify: At rest (paused) census shows NA and WATR not yet touching in sodium_fire_demo, CAC2 and its WATR drip separated by an air gap in carbide_lamp, and MG only touching OXYG/FIRE at its own tip in mg_flare -- nothing reacts until a cell is deliberately triggered.
pitfalls: NA+WATR/DSTW is genuinely violent (+600 K, ignites the H2 byproduct) -- never build this with a conductive enclosure or near stored fuel/logic
CAC2+water makes flammable acetylene GAS -- only ignite the vented gas at the nozzle, never inside the sealed chamber
Real magnesium fires cannot be extinguished with water or CO2 (both react with burning Mg) -- keep any fire-suppression element away from mg_flare
CAO+water is a real +300 K exotherm (lime slaking) even though dry CAO is inert -- treat lime_kiln's charge as live the moment water is added
This practice was authored and compiled offline (2026-08-26); it has not yet been run live in-sim
practices.scale_up: One containment cell per reactive chemistry, one shared inert corridor between cells, and a single remote spark/valve trigger per cell (see wire_a_signal) so no two hazard demos can be set off by the same accidental touch.

practices.name: energy_storage_bank
practices.goal: Three independent energy-storage mechanisms side by side: a PCM thermal buffer, a molten NAS battery rack, and a superconducting-magnet LHE dewar.

steps.do: Route any surplus CU-bus power from electrical_generation_chain into nas_battery_rack to keep it above 300 C; route TEG/condenser waste heat into pcm_thermal_battery instead of venting it; keep cryo_dewar_lhe on its own insulated shaft, isolated from both hot subsystems.

practices.verify: Over 300 frames: pcm_thermal_battery's PCMP core holds within a few K of 58 C while heat is added or removed; nas_battery_rack's NAS core stays above 300 C without external heating once initialized at 320 C; cryo_dewar_lhe's LHE bath stays at -269 C with the NBTI coil particle count unchanged.
pitfalls: PCMP above its 250 C decomposition point turns to SMKE and the buffer's charge is lost for good -- never let waste heat routed into pcm_thermal_battery exceed that
NAS below ~300 C freezes solid to SALT and stops functioning -- nas_battery_rack's AERO liner only slows the cool-down, it does not stop it, so a real build needs a standing trickle heater
Cryogenic liquids spawn at ambient temperature unless given an explicit cold props -- cryo_dewar_lhe's LHE bath must keep its temp_c: -269 prop or it flashes to NBLE immediately
This practice was authored and compiled offline (2026-08-26); it has not yet been run live in-sim
practices.scale_up: Size nas_battery_rack to the CU-bus load from electrical_generation_chain; add a status_display TSNS ladder on each of the three modules so an operator can see which store is charged without opening the cabinet.
